name: Random Number Generator Evaluation
description: Assessment of hardware true random number generators and physical entropy sources in embedded and secure devices. Covers noise source design and physics characterization, entropy source health testing in hardware, conditioning circuit review, statistical testing of raw TRNG output (NIST SP 800-90B, BSI AIS 20/31), and assessment of TRNG resilience to environmental manipulation (temperature, voltage, EM interference). Software DRBG and SP 800-90A/C assessment belongs to CRYPTO-IMPL-ENTROPY.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to hardware RNG evaluation

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands hardware RNG architectures and evaluation standards
evidence: Can explain TRNG vs. DRBG/PRNG and common hardware entropy sources (ring oscillator, metastable, thermal noise)
Understands the purpose of health tests, conditioning, and output statistical testing
Aware of relevant standards (BSI AIS 20/31, NIST SP 800-90B, BSI technical guidelines)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Collects RNG output and runs statistical tests under supervision
evidence: Extracts raw RNG output from a target device via debug interface or firmware
Runs NIST SP 800-90B entropy assessment tools or AIS 20/31 statistical test procedures on collected RNG data with guidance
Interprets statistical test results (entropy estimates, bias, correlation) with support
Documents RNG output collection methodology and test results

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently evaluates hardware RNG implementations against relevant standards
evidence: Characterizes entropy source behavior under normal operating conditions
Evaluates health test implementation and coverage in firmware/hardware
Performs AIS 20/31 or SP 800-90B evaluation and interprets results independently
Assesses RNG conditioning function and seeding mechanism adequacy
Completed RNG evaluations on 3+ distinct hardware RNG implementations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Tests RNG under adversarial conditions; assesses resilience to manipulation; mentors team
evidence: Assesses RNG behavior under environmental stress (temperature extremes, voltage variation, EM interference)
Identifies weaknesses in entropy source design through physical characterization
Evaluates stochastic models of hardware entropy sources for theoretical entropy estimation
Mentors team on RNG evaluation methodology and standard interpretation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on hardware RNG evaluation; contributes to standards; defines methodology
evidence: Defines the lab's RNG evaluation methodology aligned with AIS 20/31 and SP 800-90B
Published research on RNG evaluation techniques or entropy source analysis
Contributes to RNG evaluation standards or certification body guidance
Provides expert consultation on hardware RNG design to semiconductor vendors

assessment_methods.description: Evaluate a hardware RNG: extract raw output, run statistical tests, assess health testing, and produce an evaluation report against a specified standard
Review RNG evaluation reports for statistical rigor, standard compliance, and completeness of entropy source assessment

equipment: Environmental chamber for temperature-controlled RNG testing
